title: test(floors): floors set at today's measured value and two-sided baselines red on every legitimate deletion — ui package counts in ~8 places, CLI command counts, catalog entries pinned 4×, slot-lookup-class baselines that fail on a decrease
body:
Filing gate: ③ maintainer-directed. Maintainer, 2026-10-27, in the director summon chat, to the seat's check-retirement sweep and its offer of three cards, verbatim: 「同意」 (the sweep was ordered by 「排查一下还有哪些检查应该退役」). Filed by the director seat (`session_01KrKXQVvgYk2AJ4VkqMobyb`, ledger objectstack#12708, sweep record 6433263738). ⛔ Not a claim. Batch-of: 11 (director seat, 2026-10-27). Dedupe: 600 newest open + closed issues grepped for the check's file name → 0 unless stated. Reader: `domain:ui` for the ui floors, `domain:server`/cli for the CLI floors, `domain:devx` for the baselines. One PR per lane; `Part of` lines point here. Not a child of the transcription-pin parent: these are ratchets that should stay, loosened.

## 维护者速读

这些不是转录钉，是「防空值」底线和单向棘轮，该留；问题是底线被设在**今天的实测值**上（删一个包、一个命令、一个目录条目就红），以及一批基线**减少也红**（删个文件得跑 `--update`）。#26343 删一个 ui 包就改了五处底线。改法只有一条：底线取防空值（先例 `vite-dts-wiring-ratchet`：实测 22，底线 15），基线减少直接通过。

## Measured (`origin/main` `e677770a`)

- ui published-package population appears in about eight places: `ui/QUICK_REFERENCE.md:90` "36 published packages" (asserted by `quick-reference-commands-4149.test.ts:339–365`); `package-files-exist.test.ts:236–237, 448, 811–812` floors ≥38/150/37/36/130 "just under the measured values"; `side-effects-declaration-consistency.test.ts:1081–1083` ≥28/11/17; `check-dist-completeness.test.ts:272` ≥11; `zero-test-member-exclusion-9106.test.ts:211, 222` and `check-doc-links.test.ts:519, 524` (looser); `check-node-esm-load.mjs:163` and `check-published-dist-tooling.mjs:158` `MIN_PACKAGES = 30` twice.
- Floors equal to the measured value: `packages/cli/test/exit-signal.pin.test.ts:489–492` (65/131/46), `refusal-renders-once.test.ts:226–228` (60/50/3), `packages/spec/scripts/liveness/tombstoned-row-status.test.ts:90` (40); `ui/examples/schema-catalog` entry floor pinned in four tests with two different values (≥431 ×3, ≥423 ×1).
- Two-sided baselines (a decrease also fails until `--update`): `scripts/slot-lookup-baseline.json`, `query-options-erasure-baseline.json`, `role-word-baseline.json`, `i18n-coverage-baseline.json`, `corpus-claim-drift-baseline.json`, `objectql-double-limit`, `where-matcher-conformance`, `optional-error-sink-contract`, `durability-*`, `published-readme-exports` and their `check-*-ratchet.mjs` readers (lint.yml :4504, :4387, :2326, :2356, :2333, :3891, :3867; typecheck-consumers :6575).

## Wanted

1. Every anti-vacuity floor moves to roughly two thirds of today's value (the vite-dts precedent) and is written once per population: the ui package count in one shared constant read by the eight sites; the `QUICK_REFERENCE.md` prose number deleted (the test already derives the count).
2. The schema-catalog floor lives in one place with one value.
3. Two-sided baselines become one-sided: a decrease passes and is reported, an increase fails; `--update` stays for the report. The eslint-ignore couplings of slot-lookup and query-options are re-read in the same PR.
⛔ Not here: any shrink-only ceiling or policy budget (skills tokens, skill lines, type-check debt, exemption ceilings) — those are rulings, not floors.

## Acceptance

Deleting one ui package, one CLI command or one catalog entry reds no floor; deleting a file listed in a baseline reds no ratchet; every remaining floor is below its measured value by a stated margin named in the PR body. **Size:** M across three lanes. **Clause-②:** no. **Metadata-protocol:** none.

## Related

PR #26343 (five floor bumps for one deletion); #26410 (the census pin, ruled C); parent #26431 (the transcription pins, a different class).
